verdict.rationale: The evidence documents cubic's own MCP server, which coding agents connect to. That is the server role and does not show that cubic can consume external MCP servers. Its native integrations (Datadog, Jira, Linear, Notion, Confluence) are adjacent features, not a way to plug arbitrary MCP servers into cubic, so there is no evidence it acts as an MCP client.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
